environment.description: AWS Lambda function running in Step Functions workflow. Runtime: Python 3.11 on Amazon Linux 2023 base. Function has 512MB memory, 60s timeout. IAM role grants s3:GetObject and states:SendTaskSuccess. No filesystem restrictions beyond standard Lambda /tmp. Step Functions state machine accepts external API Gateway input for taskType and payload fields without input validation at the state machine definition level (no JSONPath filtering or InputPath restrictions).
